title: Web Audio Worklet — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Web Audio Worklet's rich face, its first round at Sketch tier and still a proposal: two made pieces that put the Gotchas to the ear and the meter (the splice, where a grain may jump; two places, where stereo is asked for), and Murmuration's knee and ceiling gathered beside the Recipe and the footprint they answer. I grow when Loudon has heard them; I never hold the entry's words.

offers.what: Fact. The idiom `const outR = out[1] || out[0]` stops the throw on a one-channel node but does not keep the sound: on a node not asked for two, a loop that writes left then right leaves only the right voice, in both ears; Murmuration.html's guarded form (lines 337 and 366) leaves only the left. Rendered offline in headless Chromium 147 on the piece's own worklet, voices at 0.2: idiom, left voice 0.000 and right 0.200 in each ear; guard, left 0.200 and right 0.000. Folding when out[1] is missing (`mono ? 0.5·(L+R)`) keeps both, at 0.100 each. Offer: 'the idiom stops the throw, but on a one-channel node it keeps only one side; fold to mono there, or always ask for two.'

Wording. 'A thrown channel-count mismatch' is, measured, a TypeError on the missing out[1] at the first sample: the node gets one channel, processorerror fires, and both ears go silent until the node is rebuilt, not just the right. Offer: 'silent-right, or a thrown error that silences the node in both ears.'

An addition, measured; the gotcha itself holds. On the splice's own worklet in node: at the window's zero the largest step a jump puts in the sound is 6.6e-7 of full scale; slid to a share a of the grain, the average step follows the Hann window w(a) exactly (the same jumps, scaled), and mid-grain the top end rises 35 dB for one grain. A crowd doesn't hide it: with 4, 16 and 32 grains of a sine the top end rises 26.6, 30.2 and 29.1 dB mid-grain; a bright eight-harmonic table hides some, not all (about 16 dB). Offer, if wanted: 'a dense cloud doesn't mask it.'

Numbers. Re-run today on the page's own flock (Murmuration's check, all pass): at η 0, seed 7, φ starts at 0.099 and climbs past 0.9 at 5.7 s, 0.964 after 60 s; at η 0.80 it averages 0.114, the floor for sixty random headings, √(π/240). Offer: 'climbing from 0.10 past 0.9' for '0.10→0.93', and '0.11' for 'collapsing to 0.10'.

Fact, out of date, carried from Murmuration's face (its offers 1, 3 and 6; not re-measured here). The mapping the Recipe describes (pitch by screen height with a Doppler term, grain density by speed) is the first build's; since 2026-10-14 the instrument defaults to the order mapping (Murmuration.html:463, map 'order': heading is pitch). Under the first mapping the sound's pitch focus did not follow the flock (3.38 to 3.46 bits of pitch-class entropy); under the order mapping it narrows to a cluster of five or six pitch classes, not one tone. And η 0.80 now lies past the instrument's Disorder slider, which tops out at η 0.25 (η = 0.25·x², Murmuration.html:467). Offer: name both mappings, 'toward a tone' for 'pitched tone', and note the slider's range beside η 0.80.

Fact, out of date. Two of the three things asked for are built: flock-as-distribution and the predator startle are both in Murmuration.html (Listen by: density; Predator: startle wave, line 156), and the voice ceiling is profiled in headless Chrome (clean through 420 birds, strained from 480, over at 720 with 858 dropouts; Projects/Murmuration/ceiling/ceiling-headless-chrome.json). Cross-browser (Firefox, Safari) is still unmeasured. Offer: mark those two progressed, and leave cross-browser and the RNBO crossover as what's left.

pieces.by: the Maker · Web Audio Worklet, one processor, five loops
pieces.title: Two places · four steps
pieces.caption: **Ask in both places, and what the idiom costs.** A low voice for the left ear and a higher one for the right, from one worklet; then the node asked for two channels with only one written (the right ear silent); then two written that were never asked for (a TypeError on the first sample, and both ears silent); then the test: the defensive idiom `out[1] || out[0]` on a node that wasn't asked. Rendered offline in headless Chromium 147 on the piece's own worklet: the idiom stops the throw but keeps one voice, the right one, in both ears; Murmuration's guarded form keeps the left; folding to mono keeps both. Each ear is metered and its voices named, so it reads without headphones. Firefox and Safari unmeasured; heard by no ear.

pieces.file: Web Audio Worklet — rich — the splice.html
pieces.by: the Maker · Web Audio Worklet, measuring its own jumps
pieces.title: The splice · four steps
pieces.caption: **Where a grain may jump.** One Hann-windowed grain; then a jump to a random read position each time the window shuts; then the jump slid toward the middle of the grain; then the test, a cloud of sixteen switched between the two. The worklet measures the step every jump puts in the sound. On its own code in node: at the window's zero the largest is 6.6e-7 of full scale; slid off the zero, the average step follows the window exactly (0.004 of the mid-grain step at a share of 0.02, a half at 0.25), and mid-grain one grain's top end rises 35 dB. The crowd doesn't hide it: 26.6 to 30.2 dB at 4 to 32 grains of a sine, about 16 dB with a bright table. Where the click becomes audible is the ear's call, and no ear has heard it yet.
pieces.near: Granular phase-scatter must land at the Hann envelope zero

pieces.title: the voice ceiling, climbed · Murmuration's steward, cycle 5
pieces.caption: The sentence's sixty birds, measured: the worklet's process() takes 24% of each block's time on average, with no dropouts. The climb goes on, one strike a step: clean through 420 birds (59%), strained from 480 (66%), over at 720 (101%, 858 dropouts). Headless Chrome, 48 kHz, 128-sample blocks, on this Mac; Firefox and Safari unmeasured.

pieces.title: the knee · Murmuration's face, four steps
pieces.caption: **The Recipe's phase transition, played and measured.** Gathered from Murmuration's face, where it is also a proposal: the page's own flock, equal to the engine over 1200 frames, heard through the same Blob-URL grain worklet this Recipe describes, walked up from one bird to the Disorder knee. Re-run today: at η 0, seed 7, φ climbs from 0.099 past 0.9 in 5.7 s (0.964 after 60 s, where the text says 0.93); at η 0.80 it sits at 0.114, the floor for sixty random headings (the text says 0.10). The wobble peaks at the knee at every size from 30 to 240 birds: a real transition, turning continuously and steeply at the sizes the instrument plays. Heard by no ear.

pieces.title: φ against η · Murmuration's steward, cycle 1
pieces.caption: The knee from eight starts, with slow sweeps up and down: the whole transition lives in η 0 to 0.15. On the first build's linear slider it sat in the first sixth of the travel; the instrument now squares the slider so the knee sits mid-way, and η 0.80 lies past its end.
